summary: Clamps the float value stored at this->offset 0 into the inclusive range [a2, a3]: below a2 sets it to a2, above a3 sets it to a3, otherwise unchanged.

local_names.this: pointer to the float value being clamped (offset 0)

operations.description: Checks whether *this is below the lower bound a2 to select the lower-clamp path.
Sets *this to a2 when the value is below the lower bound.
When not below the lower bound, checks whether *this is above the upper bound a3 to select the upper-clamp path.
Sets *this to a3 when the value is above the upper bound.
Void return; the value is left unchanged when it already lies within [a2, a3].

clean_pseudocode: if (*this < a2) { *this = a2; } else if (*this > a3) { *this = a3; }
